Trump Campaigns in Ohio and Alaska Amidst Voter Doubts

Donald Trump held a rally in Ohio as part of his campaign efforts for Republicans in tight races, also scheduled to campaign in Alaska. While Trump and J.D. Vance are backing Vivek Ramaswamy, some voters, including a Latino Trump supporter, are reportedly reconsidering their support ahead of the elections. Reports indicate that some Trump voters in Ohio are questioning his continued focus on their interests, and his global challenges are intensifying weeks before the elections.
